senses.gloss: Sumahābala, an ancient king. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 323 (in the palace of Yama).
Sumahāsvana = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Sumāla, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 279 (Arjuna): II, 27, 1029 (only C., B. has Colān, vanquished by Arjuna on his digvijaya).
Sumallika, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 362 (in Bhāratavarsha).
Sumana, a Gandharva(?). § 266 (Śakrasabhāv.): II, 7, 303 (in the palace of Indra).
Sumanā, a Kaikeyī. § 764 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 123, 5859 (Kaikeyī), 5864, 5878 (discourse with Śāṇḍilī).
Sumanas^1, a king. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 120 (Kirātarājaḥ?, waited upon Yudhishṭhira)
Sumanas^2, an ancient king. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 322 (in the palace of Yama).
Sumanas^3, an Asura. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 365 (among the Daityas and Dānavas in the palace of Varuṇa).
Sumaṇḍala, a king. § 279 (Arjuna): II, 26, 997 (in the north, vanquished by Arjuna on his digvijaya).
Sumaṅgalā, a mātṛ. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 46, 2630.
Sumaṇi, a companion of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2534 (given to Skanda by Soma).
Sumanomukha, a serpent. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 103, 3628.

Sumantu, a ṛshi, disciple of Vyāsa. § 78 (Vyāsa): I, 63, 2418 (Vyāsa taught his disciples the Vedas and the Mhbhr. as the fifth).--§ 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 106 (among the munis who waited upon Yudhishṭhira).--§ 637 (Rajādh.): XII, 47, 1592 (Aśmaka-Sºunā(!), among the ṛshis who surrounded Bhīshma on his arrow-bed).--§ 707 (Mokshadh.): XII, 319, 11743.--§ 714 (Śukakṛtya): XII, 328, 12337. --§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 341, 13025; 350, 13647.
Sumanyu^1, a Devagandharva. § 191 (Arjuna): I, 123, 4814 (present at the birth of Arjuna; only C., B. has Bhumanyuḥ).
Sumanyu^2 (XIII, 6266), v. Bhūmanyu.
Sumati^1, an Asura. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 365 (among the Daityas and Dānavas in the palace of Varuṇa).
Sumati^2, a ṛshi. § 734 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 26, 1761 (came to see Bhīshma).
Sumedhas = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Sumeru = Meru: VI, 2078 (ºr iva Bhānunā, sc paramopetaḥ, only B., C. has Svayambhur).
Sumīḍha, a prince. § 152 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3720 (second son of Suhotra).
Sumitra^1, an ancient king. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 229 (in Sañjaya's enumeration).

Sumitra^2, one or more kings at the time of Yudhishṭhira. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2699 (among the incarnations from the Krodhavaśa gaṇa).--§ 211 (Sambhavap.): I, 139, 5537 (Sauvīraṃ, also named Dattāmitra, vanquished by Arjuna).--§ 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 120 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).--§ 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 29, 1069 (vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya).--§ 281 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1108 (vanquished by Sahadeva on his digvijaya).
Sumitra^3, a muni. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 105 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).
Sumitra^4, a god. § 492 (Āṅgirasa): III, 220, 14167 (among the 15 yajñamushaḥ).
Sumitra^5, the charioteer of Abhimanyu. § 593 (Abhimanyuvadhap.): VII, 35, 1537; 36, 1547. Cf. Sūtaja.
Sumitra^6, a Haihaya king. § 641 (Rājadh.): XII, 125, 4629 (itihāsaṃ Sºsya nirvṛttam Ṛshabhasya ca), 4630 (rājarshir Haihayaḥ); 126, 4648 (Haihayānāṃ kule jātaḥ); 128, 4713 (instructed by Ṛshabha).
Sumitrā, wife of Daśaratha. § 525 (Rāmopaknyānap.): III, 274, 15879 (mother of Lakshmaṇa and Śatrughna).-§ 527 (do.): III, 277, 15980.

Sumukha^1, a serpent. § 47 (Sarpanāmak.): I, 35, 1559. --§ 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 103, 3639 (Nāgarāṭ, of Airāvata's race, grandson of Āryaka, daughter's son of Vāmana, and son of Cikura); 104, 3648, 3653, 3659, 3664, 3665, 3668 (married Guṇakeśī; on account of his being destined to be eaten by Garuḍa, Indra bestowed on him length of days); 105, 3704 (Vishṇu threw S. upon the breast of Garuḍa).

Sumukha^2, one or more Suparṇas, sons (grandsons) of Garuḍa. § 564 (Mātalīyop.): V, 101, 3587; (), 3597.-§ 574b (Jambūkh.): The bird S., the son of Suparṇa (i.e. Garuḍa) beholding that all the birds on Meru were of golden plumage, resolved to leave that mountain as there was no difference there between good, middling, and bad birds: VI, 6, 208 (Suparṇasyātmajaḥ).
Sumukha^3, a ṛshi. § 265 (Lokapālasabhākhyānap.): II, 5, 145 (accompanied Nārada).
Sumukha^4, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 127, 5177.
Sumukha^5 = Śiva (1000 names^1--2).--Do.^6 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Sumukhī, an Apsaras. § 731b (Ashṭāvakra-Diksaṃvāda): XIII, 19, 1425 (daneed in the abode of Kubera).
